entities.name: Human KDM4E
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt reference B2RXH2; length 506 aa.
JmjN domain spans approximately residues 16–50 and JmjC domain approximately residues 176–292 by Pfam.
Nuclear histone lysine demethylase; curated annotations support H3K9 and H3K56 demethylation.
Requires one Fe(2+) cofactor per subunit and belongs to EC 1.14.11.66.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular mass 56.8 kDa, theoretical pI 7.95, GRAVY −0.51, predicted net charge at pH 7 approximately +3.2.
C-terminal region is low-complexity/disordered and contains glycine-rich and strongly basic/arginine-rich segments, consistent with regulatory or chromatin-interaction roles.

entities.name: KDM4E JmjN
observations: JmjN domain detected at residues 16–50; likely forms the functional catalytic module together with JmjC.

entities.name: KDM4E JmjC
observations: JmjC domain detected at residues 176–292; characteristic Fe(2+)/2-oxoglutarate-dependent oxygenase catalytic domain.

entities.name: Fe(2+)
observations: Curated KDM4E annotation states that one Fe(2+) ion is bound per subunit.

entities.name: Histone H3 lysine demethylation
observations: KDM4E demethylates methylated histone H3 Lys-9 and also H3 Lys-56 according to curated reference annotation; reactions use 2-oxoglutarate and O2 and produce formaldehyde, succinate, and CO2.
